output.brief: The week of 26 Oct is not a real alarm. Ratequote's 5xx rate was 0.41%, below the service's normal upper band of 0.48% built from the prior 26 weeks (mean 0.35%). The error budget burn was 0.82x, well under the 2x paging line. The dashboard figures match a recount from the raw load balancer logs, so the rise is not a counting artifact. Booking completion held steady (41.0% to 41.2%), so there is no sign customers were hurt. The release link is not established: the rollout comparison was confounded by freshly started pods, and the read replica move and partner-sync month-end run were not ruled out. Confidence that the rise is ordinary variation is moderate, not certain. Recommended next steps: do not roll back v4.18 today, do not mute alerting (that would switch off the burn-rate page), and do not move the replica back yet. Record the week at ops review as within the normal band and apply the standard check to next week. If the rate breaches the band or the burn page fires, open an incident then. Ask partner-sync to confirm when their month-end run happened.
